metaDescription: Ask for a mentor, an experienced Muslim matched with you by our team to help with the questions you might feel shy asking.
title: Talk to a mentor
guestLead: A mentor is someone to ask the questions you might feel shy asking.
mentorLead: These are the people our team has matched with you.
revertLead: Ask for a mentor and our team will match you with someone experienced who can help.
whatIsMentor: A mentor is a volunteer, an experienced Muslim, matched with you by our team. They are someone to ask the questions you might feel shy asking, about prayer, daily life, or anything else on your mind.
step1: You ask. Tell us a little about what you would find helpful, if you like.
step2: Our team matches you with a mentor who fits what you are looking for.
step3: Your mentor reaches out to you by email to start the conversation.
signInCta: Sign in to request a mentor
onboardingPrompt: Finish setting up your account before you request a mentor.
